info.name: psmadmin
info.description:
PSM HTTP API collection generated from the Laravel routes in this repository.

Set collection variables before sending requests:
- base_url: API origin, without a trailing slash. .env.example uses http://localhost. Existing requests may still use {{Localhost}} or https://prosubmarket.cgstagingsite.com.
- jwt_token: bearer token returned by Login as `token`. The Login request stores it here and in localToken.
- partner_api_key: provider key from Generate Provider API Key (`data.api_key`). Partner routes also accept the same value in the X-API-KEY header.

JWT routes use Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}.
Partner routes use Authorization: Bearer {{partner_api_key}}.
Public routes send no credential.
Admin company-referral routes use the web admin session (auth, verified, admin.access), not the mobile JWT.

Sample bodies come from FormRequest rules or controller validate()/Validator::make() calls. Fields that could not be confirmed are called out in the request description. Example responses are illustrative, not captured production payloads.

Do not put real passwords, API keys, or customer data in this collection.

Authentication: Authorization: Bearer {{partner_api_key}} or header X-API-KEY. The key must be active, unexpired, and unrevoked; the company and user must be provider accounts; Open API must be enabled; the key needs the chat scope. Legacy null scopes are products-only and cannot call this route.

Conversation mapping is stored per company, external_system, and external_conversation_id. The first message for a thread must include psm_conversation_id for a conversation that includes the authenticated company. Later messages may omit psm_conversation_id. There is no lookup by company name or email.

external_system must be rentman or flex (case-insensitive; stored lowercase). body is trimmed and must be 1–2000 characters. external_message_id and external_conversation_id are trimmed and max 191 characters. external_created_at is stored on the link only; unread counts use the PSM message created_at.

Idempotency key: company + external_system + external_message_id.
- First accept: HTTP 201, message "Message sent.", data.id is the new PSM message id. One chat_messages row is created, ChatMessageSent is broadcast as chat.message.sent, and ProcessChatMessageNotificationsJob is queued.
- Identical retry: HTTP 200, message "Existing message returned.", same data.id. No second message, broadcast, or notification.
- Same id with a different body or external conversation: HTTP 409.
- external_conversation_id already mapped to another PSM conversation: HTTP 409.

Other errors: 401 missing/invalid/revoked key; 403 expired key, Open API disabled, non-provider account, missing chat scope, or a conversation the company is not in; 404 unknown conversation or missing mapping; 422 validation or missing default contact; 429 {"success":false,"message":"Too many requests."}.

This route does not call the AI chatbot and does not send anything outbound to Rentman or Flex.
